source_record.description:
Business Analyst / ATP & Order Fulfilment

Experience 5+ Yrs

Location: Germany / Remote

Project language: English

For the life sciences sector, we are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with expertise in ATP / AATP (Available-to-Promise) and Order Fulfillment processes to support a large SAP OTC initiative. The focus of the project is the business-side analysis and further development of ATP and Order Fulfillment processes.

Tasks

Qualifications:

  • Several years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Expert or Functional Consultant
  • Proven experience within Pharma, Biotechnology or Life Sciences environments
  • Strong understanding of ATP (Available-to-Promise) and Order Fulfillment processes
  • Experience with Product Allocation, Backorder Processing and Substitution processes
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria and test scripts
  • Experience with UAT and business validation activities
  • Ability to understand and analyze process reporting and business KPIs
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Cash processes
  • Experience working in international projects
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluent English
  • German and/or French would be advantageous

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze ATP and Order Fulfillment processes from a business perspective
  • Gather, structure and document business requirements
  • Develop business scenarios related to Product Allocation, Substitution and Backorder Processing
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria and business requirements
  • Prepare and execute business testing and UAT activities
  • Develop and maintain test scripts and test scenarios
  • Analyze process reports and derive business recommendations
  • Identify process gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Document business rules and process decisions
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements for the implementation team
  • Contribute ATP and Order Fulfillment best practices from Life Sciences environments
  • Act as a business representative for ATP-related processes
